protocol_scope.protocol_version: Science 2018 published version (Rosenberg et al., Science 360:176-182)

states.name: Cellular mRNA in fixed permeabilized cells
states.physical_state: in situ within formaldehyde-fixed cells or nuclei
properties: fixed and permeabilized cells or nuclei

states.name: mRNA:cDNA hybrid carrying round 1 barcode
properties: round 1 barcode is well-specific (up to 48 wells)
random hexamer and poly(dT)15VN primers combined in each well

segments.role: anchored poly(dT)15VN or random hexamer priming region

states.name: mRNA:cDNA hybrid carrying round 1 and round 2 barcodes
properties: round 2 barcode ligated to the 5' end of the RT primer
transient BC_0215 linker strand not carried forward

segments.role: round 2 barcode oligo arm complementary to the round 3 linker
round 2 barcode oligo arm hybridized to the BC_0215 linker

states.name: mRNA:cDNA hybrid carrying three barcodes, UMI and PCR handle

segments.role: round 3 barcode oligo arm hybridized to the BC_0060 linker

states.name: Biotinylated single-stranded barcoded cDNA on streptavidin beads
states.physical_state: bound to Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin C1 beads in lysate
properties: template mRNA removed during lysis and reverse crosslinking

states.name: Amplified double-stranded barcoded cDNA with TSO sequence
states.physical_state: in solution after bead removal and SPRI purification

segments.role: TSO template-switching 3' end incorporated as DNA
untemplated C overhang copied from the TSO

states.name: Tagmented amplifiable fragment (s5 adapter at one end, 3' cDNA end at the other)
states.physical_state: in solution after Nextera XT tagmentation and neutralization
properties: only fragment carrying s5 at one end and the 3' cDNA end at the other is amplifiable with BC_0118 and BC_0076-BC_0083
s5/s5, s7/s7, s5/s7 and s7/3'-end products are not amplifiable

states.name: Final indexed Illumina sequencing library
properties: Read 1 66 nt reads the cDNA insert
Read 2 94 nt reads UMI and the three cell barcodes
index read 6 nt reads the sublibrary index

segments.role: Nextera mosaic end / Read 1 primer site

transitions.operation_detail: In-cell reverse transcription in up to 48 wells with well-specific barcoded anchored poly(dT)15VN and random hexamer primers using Maxima H Minus reverse transcriptase; cells are pooled afterwards.

Round 2 adapters are pre-annealed from the BC_0215 linker and well-specific round 2 barcode strands (95C to 20C at -0.1C/s), cells are split into a 96-well plate, and T4 DNA ligase joins the barcode to the 5' end of the RT primer for 30 min at 37C; BC_0216 blocking strand is then added and cells are pooled.

Round 3 adapters are pre-annealed from the BC_0060 linker and biotinylated round 3 barcode strands carrying a 10-nt UMI and the universal PCR handle; ligation for 30 min at 37C in a second 96-well plate, then BC_0066 blocking strand in EDTA terminates ligase activity and cells are pooled.

Cells are counted and split into sublibraries, lysed with SDS lysis buffer and proteinase K at 55C for 2 h to reverse formaldehyde crosslinks, PMSF-quenched, and the biotinylated barcoded cDNA is captured on Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin C1 beads and washed; the RNA template is removed.

Template switching on beads with the rGrG+G template switch primer BC_0127 and Maxima H Minus reverse transcriptase (30 min RT, 90 min 42C) generates the second strand carrying the ISPCR handle; the same duplex is then amplified in one PCR with BC_0062 and BC_0108 (Kapa HiFi HotStart, 5 cycles plus EvaGreen-monitored qPCR cycling) and purified with 0.8X SPRI beads, without changing strand architecture.

600 pg of purified cDNA is tagmented with the Nextera XT Amplicon Tagment enzyme in TD buffer at 55C for 5 min and neutralized; the Tn5 dimer produces s5/s5, s7/s7 and s5/s7 internal fragments plus s7 or s5 fragments retaining the 3' cDNA end, and only the s5 fragment retaining the 3' barcoded end is amplifiable with the primer pair used in the next step.

Indexing PCR with BC_0118 (P5 side) and one indexed primer BC_0076-BC_0083 (P7 side), 12 cycles, adds P5, the fixed i5-position sequence, the 6-nt i7 sublibrary index and P7; 40 uL of the reaction is purified with 0.7X SPRI beads to give the sequencing-ready library.
